h:
此工作流程旨在放大或缩小图像尺寸以进行 LoRA 训练或您可能有的任何其他原因。使用侧面的注释了解设置和信息。

要使用工作流程，请按照注释中的说明进行设置。然后，将“运行”批处理大小设置为文件夹中的图像数量（或者只需单击“运行”您希望其运行的次数）。图像批量加载器每次运行时都会自动增加索引号，直到您将 reload_directory 或 reset_index 设置为 true。

o.en:
This workflow is designed to enlarge or reduce image sizes for LoRA training or any other reason you may have. Use the notes on the sides for settings and info.

To use the workflow, set up per the instructions in the notes. Then, set your RUN batch size to the number of images in your folder (or just hit run the number of times you want it to run). The Image Batch Loader with automatically increment the index number each time it's run until you set reload_directory or reset_index to true.
